blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 Two-time Olympic champion Carlos Yulo of the Philippines said clinching his second gymnastics gold medal of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 in the men’s individual vault final on Friday felt like “a miracle.” The 26-year-old qualified seventh for the eight-man final on Monday after a bad landing on the first of his two qualification vaults put him at risk of elimination from an event in which he is the reigning Olympic champion.
